newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly lower, volume halved.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly lower, volume halved.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly lower on Friday on smaller volume and turnover.
* Of eight active issues four were down, two up and two flat.
* Volume was halved to 3,432 shares, turnover 6.7 million kuna.
* Most actively traded issue was Zagrebacka Banka, which lost 10 kuna to 980 with 1,430 units sold.
* Biggest decliner was hotelier Laguna, 50 kuna down to 1,050 on volume of 70 shares.
* Biggest gainer was Zagrebacka E-series, up 10 kuna to 430 on volume of 158 shares.
